vision.method: PNG images were passed to the assistant through view_image and their visual content was interpreted.
vision.metadata: Sharp supplied dimensions and alpha/albedo statistics; this is not vision review.
vision.pixelAnalysis: Rendered vegetation masks and display-luminance statistics supplied structured warnings; these cannot approve aesthetics.
vision.evidence: Tier 3 inspection invalidated provisional Tier 1 acceptance of cycles 2 and 4; both were rolled back.

baselineAssessment.decision: reject latest Pass 1 as a quality target, preserve it as recoverable evidence
baselineAssessment.evidence: Savanna lost grass, gained black fragments and a faceted wall. Rainforest displayed repeated dark circles and an exposed inspection boundary.

cycles.defect: Barren brown foreground and black, detached-looking plant fragments
cycles.hypothesis: Flat card response, multiplicative dark tint and a patch sampler excluding almost all nearby ground jointly cause the regression.
cycles.change: Crossed cards, upward wrapped shading normals, golden albedo treatment with light instance tints, near framing patches and broad correlated coverage; shorter grass inside the opening. No exposure increase.
cycles.evidence: Tier 1 coverage 10.54% to 73.34%; near-black mask overlap 37.2% to 0.337%. Hero and inspection regain a readable golden grass layer.
cycles.remaining: Tier 2 and Tier 3 show coarse, repeated card silhouettes; this is not final art approval.

cycles.defect: Faceted, disconnected mountain wall introduced by Pass 1
cycles.hypothesis: A sparse unlit triangle strip and independent placement make the feature look artificial.
cycles.change: Test a smooth-normal, lit heightfield with a broad talus profile.
cycles.evidence: Tier 1 improves the hero silhouette, but Tier 3 rotated inspection reveals a sky wedge beneath the left end: the feature is still disconnected.
cycles.retainedTerrain: Historical existing biome hill; both the Pass 1 faceted addition and Cycle 2 heightfield were removed.
cycles.remaining: Richer credible geology is unresolved. No new ridge is claimed as successful.

cycles.confirmedCause: 520 terrain-conforming atlas decals retained opaque, dark humus backgrounds. Four repeated substrate silhouettes contrast strongly with the newer ground material; they are not tree shadows or density-mask circles.
cycles.sourceMeasurements: Floor atlas alpha coverage 55.1%; 40.8% of alpha-covered pixels average below 50/255. Median weighted display albedo is about 58.7/255.
cycles.change: Filter decal alpha by linear albedo from .045 to .095, retaining brighter leaf/root fragments, then vary nonuniform footprint scale and harmonize tint. Terrain remains the continuous soil layer.
cycles.evidence: Circular borders disappear in the same hero and inspection views. Existing physical tree shadows, canopy and seed remain unchanged.
cycles.remaining: Litter detail is now subtle; the floor is smoother than the concept. Atlas reuse still needs visual review.

cycles.defect: Exposed ground/forest boundary from elevated inspection
cycles.confirmedCause: V5 hides its entire outer backdrop above 18 m eye height, and the terrain ends at 100 m.
cycles.change: Test a 320 m continuation annulus, persistent far-wall cards and 240 outer shrub instances.
cycles.evidence: Tier 1 hides the edge, but Tier 3 shows visually detached outer foliage and a flat teal curtain. These are new regressions rather than convincing forest depth.
cycles.retained: Original V5 continuation behavior with the successful Cycle 3 floor fix
cycles.remaining: Inspection boundary is still visible. This acceptance criterion is not met.

stopReason: Four targeted cycles used. Late validation rejected two candidates. Only rollbacks and validation followed; no fifth correction cycle was attempted.

savanna.defect: Coarse/repeated grass-card silhouettes at close range
savanna.evidence: Native hero foreground shows repeated small blade/fan forms despite continuous golden coverage.
savanna.cause: Hypothesis: three atlas variants and simple crossed surfaces dominate near-camera detail.
savanna.action: A future bounded study should improve card silhouette variation and distance representation without increasing blanket density.
savanna.decision: revise in a future budget; retain current grass over the barren baseline

savanna.defect: Distant terrain lacks a distinctive geological character
savanna.evidence: The retained historical low hill is simple; the proposed new ridge is not retained.
savanna.cause: Confirmed: intentional rollback of both unsuccessful geological additions.
savanna.action: Prove connected terrain geometry from the inspection view before adding another hero landform.
savanna.decision: do not claim the geological target is achieved

rainforest.defect: Inspection reveals a finite forest and terrain boundary
rainforest.evidence: The final-best inspection PNG shows sky and a straight outer ground silhouette beyond the trees.
rainforest.cause: Confirmed: legacy backdrop visibility threshold and finite ground extent.
rainforest.action: Next pass should test terrain and distant forest continuation alone, without new outer plant scatter or extra fog.
rainforest.decision: unresolved; stop at the allocated cycle limit

rainforest.evidence: Native hero image has a calm brown center with only small retained litter/root fragments.
rainforest.cause: Hypothesis: albedo rejection removes too much substrate-associated fine detail as well as the objectionable circles.
rainforest.action: Calibrate sparse overlapping litter detail against the concept without restoring round opaque islands.
rainforest.decision: retain the artifact fix, revise richness later

rainforest.evidence: Native foreground leaves show angular triangular fronds.
rainforest.cause: Confirmed existing shared life-form geometry; it was reused, not rebuilt in this task.
rainforest.action: Keep this separate from the higher-priority boundary correction.

nextPass: Prioritize continuous terrain and distant forest geometry from the fixed inspection view. Test that single correction before introducing any new understory or stronger haze. Keep the accepted grass/material and floor-fragment fixes frozen.
